Daraz Pakistan Customer Support — Knowledge Base
 Summary
Source: https://www.daraz.pk/contact-us/
Important: This is a concise knowledge-base summary generated from the public Daraz Pakistan source
page. It is not an official Daraz-issued PDF and should not replace the live source.
 Daraz provides a Help Center and customer-care flows for order tracking, returns, cancellations and other
questions.
 The Contact Us page provides links to returns/refunds, order help and other support resources.
 For policy-sensitive answers, the support and policy pages should be checked for the latest rules.
Source URL: https://www.daraz.pk/contact-us/

Daraz Pakistan Delivery / Order Handling — Knowledge
 Base Summary
Source: https://www.daraz.pk/terms-conditions/
Important: This is a concise knowledge-base summary generated from the public Daraz Pakistan source
page. It is not an official Daraz-issued PDF and should not replace the live source.
 Delivery and order processing are governed by Daraz's terms and applicable product/order information.
 Customers should provide a complete and accurate shipping address and accept delivery.
 If an item arrives defective or differs from the order, customers are directed to follow the applicable Daraz
return process rather than reject delivery solely for that reason.
 Delivery, shipping and rejection rules can vary by order and product.
Source URL: https://www.daraz.pk/terms-conditions/

Daraz Pakistan Payments — Knowledge Base
 Summary
Source: https://sellercenter.daraz.pk/v2/home
Important: This is a concise knowledge-base summary generated from the public Daraz Pakistan source
page. It is not an official Daraz-issued PDF and should not replace the live source.
 Daraz Seller Center states that seller payments are based on orders marked Delivered.
 The Seller Center states that delivered-product payments are settled weekly, subject to the stated
business-day handling.
 Daraz's customer terms require transactions and payments to remain within the Daraz platform.
 Payment/refund availability and timing can depend on the payment method and order status.
Source URL: https://sellercenter.daraz.pk/v2/home

Daraz Pakistan Refund Policy — Knowledge Base
 Summary
Source: https://www.daraz.pk/refund-policy/
Important: This is a concise knowledge-base summary generated from the public Daraz Pakistan source
page. It is not an official Daraz-issued PDF and should not replace the live source.
 Eligible refunds depend on the return/quality-check process and the selected refund method.
 Daraz states that shipping fees are refunded along with the returned product amount when applicable.
 Published refund timelines vary by payment method; examples include card refunds in working days and
Daraz Wallet refunds that can be much faster.
 Failed/false-delivery prepaid orders can have different refund timelines from ordinary returns.
 Refund rules can change, so the official policy page should be treated as the current source.
Source URL: https://www.daraz.pk/refund-policy/

Daraz Pakistan Return Policy — Knowledge Base
 Summary
Source: https://www.daraz.pk/return-policy/
Important: This is a concise knowledge-base summary generated from the public Daraz Pakistan source
page. It is not an official Daraz-issued PDF and should not replace the live source.
 Return requests are generally required within 14 days of delivery.
 Common eligible reasons include damaged, defective, incorrect, incomplete, or not-as-described items;
category-specific rules apply.
 Some categories/items are non-returnable or do not allow change-of-mind returns.
 Returned products generally need to be unused/unworn/unwashed, with original tags, accessories,
manuals, freebies and packaging where applicable.
 Daraz may reject a refund if the returned item does not satisfy the applicable return conditions.
Source URL: https://www.daraz.pk/return-policy/

Daraz Pakistan Seller / Marketplace Agreement —
 Knowledge Base Summary
Source: https://pages.daraz.pk/wow/i/pk/help/marketplace-agreement?hybrid=1
Important: This is a concise knowledge-base summary generated from the public Daraz Pakistan source
page. It is not an official Daraz-issued PDF and should not replace the live source.
 The Marketplace Agreement defines seller obligations, Seller Center access, shipping/dispatch
responsibilities and seller performance requirements.
 For applicable returns, sellers accept cases such as defective/damaged, incorrect and incomplete
products, with category-specific exceptions.
 Daraz may refund customers for eligible prepaid cancellations, rejected products or returned products
under the agreement.
 Seller shipping, packing and fulfilment responsibilities are governed by the agreement and related policies.
Source URL: https://pages.daraz.pk/wow/i/pk/help/marketplace-agreement?hybrid=1
